Title: Questions on Soul Burn and Hidden Lurker

Messages.Author: Eric Tullis
Messages.Body:
Greetings everyone,

A couple of questions on these two cards have come up in our last
few games. Please advise:

[1] Hidden Lurker: I know this card is now played as an action modifier
instead of an action. The V:TES wording does not mention anything about
tapping the Hidden Lurker vamp, since tapping was part of the "action".
When using the card as an action modifier, does the Lurking minion tap?
If not, can a *tapped* minion be the Lurker, a la Cloak The Gathering?

[2] Hidden Lurker: When used, the blocking minion can not use any
strikes in the first round of combat. Does this also preclude the
blocking minion from using a weapon's maneuver?

[3] Soul Burn: The relevant text of this card states: "For the
remainder of this round, the opposing minion cannot inflict damage
with weapons". Let's say that minion A strikes with a .44 Magnum
and minion B strikes with Soul Burn. Would Soul Burn only affect
*additional strikes* of the gun, or is this initial gun strike
negated as well? I think that the initial gun strike would still
do damage, as the strikes resolve simultaneously. The phrase
"remainder of this round" implies to me strikes that happen *after*
Soul Burn is used.

What if, somehow, Soul Burn was delivered with First Strike? (I'm not
sure if that can be done, just asking for argument's sake.) Then, I
think that the gun's initial strike would fizzle. Sorry if I'm
answering my own questions, but I'd be happy to have some expert
commentary on these.

Thanks in advance!
Eric Tullis

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:

> [1] Hidden Lurker: I know this card is now played as an action modifier

> When using the card as an action modifier, does the Lurking minion tap?
> If not, can a *tapped* minion be the Lurker, a la Cloak The Gathering?

It has errata to make it function like the Jyhad version would have
functioned if the Jyhad version had been printed with a action modifier
symbol:

The modifying vampire must be untapped.
The modifying vampire is tapped.

> [2] Hidden Lurker: When used, the blocking minion can not use any
> strikes in the first round of combat. Does this also preclude the
> blocking minion from using a weapon's maneuver?

Yes. No strike-based maneuvers are possible for the blocker.

> [3] Soul Burn: The relevant text of this card states: "For the
> remainder of this round, the opposing minion cannot inflict damage
> with weapons". Let's say that minion A strikes with a .44 Magnum
> and minion B strikes with Soul Burn. Would Soul Burn only affect

> negated as well? I think that the initial gun strike would still
> do damage, as the strikes resolve simultaneously. The phrase
> "remainder of this round" implies to me strikes that happen *after*
> Soul Burn is used.

Correct.

> What if, somehow, Soul Burn was delivered with First Strike? (I'm not
> sure if that can be done, just asking for argument's sake.) Then, I
> think that the gun's initial strike would fizzle. Sorry if I'm
> answering my own questions, but I'd be happy to have some expert
> commentary on these.

Correct again.
